question: Should this repository's public project name remain “clawdinators,” or be renamed to “OpenClawtinators”?
rationale: Both names are plausible branding choices, but current main consistently uses “clawdinators” and the PR provides no discussion establishing a deliberate rename.

options.title: Retain clawdinators
options.body: Close this conflicting PR and preserve the current repository-aligned heading.

options.title: Approve coordinated rename
options.body: Confirm “OpenClawtinators” as the intended name and request a refreshed PR updating all prominent naming references consistently.

recommendation.title: Retain clawdinators
recommendation.body: Close this conflicting PR and preserve the current repository-aligned heading.
